title: A Legitimate Job Admired by Everyone
overview: At a conference among industry leaders in Kaii countermeasures, Shigemoto's "Alice System" is rejected due to lack of proven results. He takes on a massive yet dangerous new project for himself to prove his abilities while questioning the industry's power dynamics and expectations. Meanwhile, a certain individual approaches Koshigaya with a suspicious proposal, putting her father on shaky ground.

title: No Logical Means of Exterminating This Kaii
overview: Kana and Koshigaya visit the RIMT to investigate and exterminate a new Kaii species. Guided by Vice Chief Akasaka, they face a bewildering and seemingly invincible Kaii specimen defying all common sense. Behind the scenes, ulterior motives surrounding magic power regulations cause tension as the Kaii unexpectedly mutates. With a strict time limit, Magilumiere's skills are put to the test.

title: Haven't Seen Delusion Like This in Ages
overview: Magical Girls from Magilumiere and AST simultaneously face a rampaging new Kaii species. Koshigaya extends an olive branch to Tsuchiba, resulting in a clash of opinions that only sparks tension between their companies. The unknown Kaii rapidly mutates under the influence of magic power, after which a certain individual takes control as operator for the do-or-die battle ahead.

title: How Exceptional His Magical Girls Are
overview: An improvised collaboration between Magilumiere and AST engages in a do-or-die fight against the rapidly mutating Class C Kaii. Magilumiere's fluctuating defensive and offensive tactics upset conventional methods as Kana gathers real-time data during battle to take control. Through physicality, precise control, and high-level guidance, the seemingly unbalanced team devises a plan to counterattack.

title: Can't Keep Acting Like a Rookie
overview: Magilumiere begins recruiting engineers to promote the Alice System. Kana struggles to convey the company's appeal while overseeing the interview process. This causes unexpected personnel to assemble, bringing the team a fresh atmosphere. When securing more talent proves difficult after serious attempts to strengthen their combat potential, Magilumiere heads to Kyoto for lectures and interviews.

title: You're Not Fit for This Job
overview: In Kyoto, Magilumiere meets engineer candidate Yamimori, who boasts impressive skills but struggles with cooperation. While compatibility with the team is called into question, he appears to be hiding certain feelings about his childhood friend Sakae and his personal values. Meanwhile, during a festival at Tonomori Shrine, a ritual unleashes a Kaii while an ominous shadow lurks behind the scenes.

title: The Battle's Already Over
overview: At the Tonomori Shrine ceremony's climax, an unknown Kaii suddenly invades a barrier once believed to be safe, enveloping the area in chaos. The barrier blocks outside forces, which separates Magilumiere's team. Makino and Akasaka are forced into a struggle within the barrier while Nikoyama searches for an opening outside. With time running out, each decision will greatly influence the outcome.

title: You Can Choose Where to Grow Up
overview: After gaining the trust of his allies, Yamimori takes action to fight the rampaging Kaii inside the sealed barrier. Makino and Akasaka also rechallenge the front lines to face the now-overpowered Kaii with harmonious teamwork and quick thinking. The dire situation demonstrates the skill and trust between Magical Girls and their engineers as the team marches onward with full hearts.

title: Are You Expecting Us to Sugarcoat This?
overview: The Kaii at Tonomori is revealed to be someone's act of sabotage promoting a scheme to ease magic regulations behind the scenes and manipulate public opinion. Then, the culprit emerges-someone entirely unexpected. While Yamimori becomes comfortable at Magilumiere, Kana decides to confront major industry norms and her own role in the process, sparking the onset of war on a much grander scale.
